chunks.heading: Overview
chunks.text: The Nimbus API supports OAuth access tokens for user-facing apps and long-lived API keys for server-to-server integrations.

chunks.heading: POST /v1/oauth/token
chunks.text:
curl -X POST https://api.nimbus.example/v1/oauth/token \
  -d client_id=CID -d client_secret=SECRET \
  -d grant_type=client_credentials
# response:
{"access_token": "nbs_...", "expires_in": 3600, "token_type": "bearer"}

chunks.heading: Refreshing tokens
chunks.text:
curl -X POST https://api.nimbus.example/v1/oauth/token \
  -d grant_type=refresh_token \
  -d refresh_token=$REFRESH_TOKEN
# returns a new access_token without requiring the user to log in again

chunks.heading: Revoking a token
chunks.text:
curl -X DELETE https://api.nimbus.example/v1/oauth/token/{token_id} \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN"
# returns 204 No Content on success
